Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.startup.orchestration

Class LifecycleManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.startup.orchestration.LifecycleManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Lifecycle, Phased, SmartLifecycle, Ordered
@Component public class LifecycleManager extends Object implements SmartLifecycle, Ordered
Manages Brobot's initialization lifecycle to ensure proper component startup order. This replaces the need for multiple InitializingBean implementations and guarantees that all components are initialized in the correct sequence.

Initialization Order:

  1. Environment detection and configuration
  2. Image path resolution and SikuliX setup
  3. Resource verification and diagnostics
  4. Framework readiness check
